run_inference_stable_diffusion: run StableDiffusionPipeline inference with a text prompt and save the generated image to disk
create_pipeline_from_pretrained: create a StableDiffusionPipeline loaded from a pretrained model checkpoint on CUDA with float16 dtype
generate_image_from_prompt: generate an image from a text prompt using StableDiffusionPipeline with specified inference steps and guidance scale
save_generated_image: save a generated image from StableDiffusionPipeline output to a PNG file
load_model_on_cuda: load a pretrained StableDiffusion model onto CUDA with float16 precision for inference
